title: Deterministic Fourier estimator program
statement: Given a small-bias Fourier input and a finite set $U$ of output coordinates, the deterministic Fourier estimator program first charges the local computation work of the deterministic generator, then runs the Fourier estimator program on the generated sample and $U$. Its query type is the set of sign vectors on the output cube, and its answer and output types are both the real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying bias input has output dimension $n>0$.
Twice the bias numerator is at most the bias denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
$U$ is a finite set of output coordinates.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the generator work or the Fourier estimator program, so their detailed behavior cannot be rendered.
